args: Perform daily read-only audit: Call GET /owner/status on the marketing organization engine using the $env:OWNER_API_KEY environment variable, extract the current open actions list, and write it to stdout. Do not make code edits. Do not trigger deployments. Do not call paid LLM APIs.
display_name: Daily Owner Status & Open Actions Audit
description: Every day at 9:00 AM (Asia/Kolkata), performs a read-only audit of /owner/status and writes the open actions list with zero code edits, zero deploys, and zero LLM tokens.
